pages.text:
Three crops that grow like wheat, on farmland or Loam Farmland (where nutrients speed them up). Find their seeds on wild plants or in grass.
- Flax (wild in plains) gives Flax Fibre and seeds. Craft one fibre into String, or four into Linen.
- Rapeseed (wild in meadows and plains) gives Rapeseeds, the oil crop. They plant more.
- Sorghum (wild in savannas) gives Sorghum Stalks and seeds. In a Fermenter a stalk makes 80 mB of Ethanol, more than any vanilla crop.
